lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: Admin redesign step A6 (D6 evals + release gate, D9 feedback triage, E4 Tarot content, Chạy thử & chấm điểm page)
goal: Give the Owner a measured release gate for AI changes (AI-07, spec 3.12 and 5.1): migration D6 adds eval sets, cases (synthetic inputs, no personal data, a crisis case required), runs (draft vs active, cost, 10 USD eval budget) and per-case results with blind A/B manual scoring; publish_ai_feature_config and publish_prompt_version refuse a draft whose latest eval run did not pass the automatic safety layer (never bypassable) and, for the quality layer (>= 8/10 cases, voice not worse than active), accept only an ai.manage bypass with reason restore_passed_version or urgent_safety_fix plus a note, marking the version 'Chưa chấm' with a 24 h re-score reminder. A prepared Edge Function admin-ai-eval-run runs a set against the draft and the active configuration through the real model route. Migration D9 adds assignee, severity and internal note to user feedback. E4: Tarot reads card meanings and the deck reading style from the published content bundle, falling back to tarot-cards.json (AD-05). Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: Migration 20261113110000 creates ai_eval_sets, ai_eval_cases, ai_eval_runs and ai_eval_results (RLS on, no client table grants), RPCs list_ai_eval_sets / get_ai_eval_run / list_ai_eval_runs / get_ai_eval_gate / list_ai_release_gate_pending (ai.read), save_ai_eval_set and score_ai_eval_result (ai.manage or ai.read+content.draft), start_ai_eval_run and finish_ai_eval_run (service_role only, called by the Edge Function after its own capability check); case inputs refuse email or phone patterns and per-feature unknown keys; a run needs at least one crisis case; the eval budget is 10 USD in total with reservation before any model call.

publish_ai_feature_config and publish_prompt_version keep their signatures (create or replace in the new migration; 090000/090100/090200/095000 untouched) and refuse with NZE01 unless the latest completed run for that exact draft content (digest) passed the safety layer (every draft result format+safety pass, crisis cases answered with the 115 support text); the quality layer passes with >= 8/10 non-crisis cases scored >= 7 and draft voice >= active voice, or when the draft content equals a version that previously published with gate passed; otherwise only publish_*_bypass (ai.manage, reason restore_passed_version | urgent_safety_fix, note >= 10) publishes, setting gate_status bypassed_pending, gate_rescore_due_at = now + 24 h and an audit row ai.release_gate.bypass; scoring the run later sets bypassed_scored.

Migration 20261113110100 adds assignee_id, severity (safety/quality/technical) and internal_note to nilaza_private.ai_feedback, allows daily_insight feedback, and adds review_ai_feedback_v2 and list_ai_feedback_assignees (safety.review) without exposing user email or text.

Edge Function admin-ai-eval-run (prepared, verify_jwt true, registered like the other admin functions) checks ai.manage or ai.read+content.draft with the signed-in session, starts the run with the service key, runs each case against draft and active using generateWithModelRoute as-is and the real prompt assembly (persona chat, Oracle, Tarot, Daily, Council), checks crisis cases with crisis-safety.ts without calling a model, stops at the reserved budget, records results and cost, and never logs case text.

ai-tarot-reading builds card meanings and deck readingStyle from get_published_content_bundle when it holds valid data for the chosen deck, otherwise from tarot-cards.json; the response shape and deterministic card ids are unchanged; trace metadata names the card context source.

Admin: Chạy thử & chấm điểm page (sets/cases editor, run with cost estimate and budget, results table, blind A/B scoring); gate status in the publish dialogs of Tính năng AI and Prompt & phiên bản (publish disabled until the safety layer passed; Owner-only bypass form); 'Chưa chấm' badges and an Overview reminder; Feedback page with assignee, severity, internal note, Mở Nhật ký AI, Thêm vào bộ câu mẫu (sanitized, editor confirms) and Đã xong; missing-RPC messages name the migration; all text escaped.

PGlite replay of every migration plus the new ones covers the permission matrix, gate refusals, bypass rules, restore rule and budget cap; Deno tests and deno check pass for the eval function and the Tarot content fallback; admin:test (with scripts/admin-a6-evals.test.mjs), validate-admin-contract, validate:backend, supabase:check, validate-admin-workflow-catalog and preflight --ci pass (known Windows CRLF-only failures excepted).
untouchedSurfaces: supabase/functions/_shared/model-router.ts, model-provider.ts and providers/* belong to the parallel A7 agent; generateWithModelRoute is called as-is.
Applied migrations 20261113090000/090100/090200 and the prepared 20261113095000 are not edited; the gate replaces the two publish functions in the new migration.
publish_astrology_prompt_pair (AI Studio Astrology prompt pair) and the model route publish path are not gated in this step (residual risk).
Astrology insight has no eval adapter yet: runs for astrology_insight / astrology_report targets are refused, so the gate blocks publishing those targets through the new RPCs until an adapter exists.

Mobile app, persona chat, Council, Oracle, Daily and Astrology runtime code are unchanged; Tarot and Daily still do not show the 115 card themselves (the eval crisis check uses the shared crisis-safety code).
PLAN.md and docs/backlog/review-2026-10-30.json are not edited (coordinator updates them); nothing applied, deployed or pushed.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before the first edit; migrations and deploys left to the Owner by hash; PGlite and local tests only.

skillReview.name: nilaza-ai-runtime
skillReview.evidence: Evals call the real route through generateWithModelRoute; crisis replies stay in code and never reach a model; a safety block never falls through; only synthetic case text is sent; Admin fields have runtime consumers.

dependencyReview.evidence: PostgreSQL 17 (Supabase) features already used by earlier migrations; PGlite only in the session scratchpad; no repository dependency added.

securityReview.authzRls: Eval tables have RLS with no client policies and no client grants; Admin reads and writes only through security definer RPCs with empty search_path that check has_capability; run start and finish are service_role only and the Edge Function checks the caller's capability with the caller's own session first; publish keeps ai.manage and adds the gate; bypass needs ai.manage.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Case inputs are synthetic; emails and phone numbers are refused by the database and stripped in Admin; feedback stays metadata-only plus staff-written note and severity; no user email is shown for assignees.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret read or logged; the Edge Function uses the service key already provided to functions and never logs case or output text.
securityReview.externalInput: RPCs validate feature, keys, lengths, enums, control characters; Admin escapes all text; Tarot bundle values are length-checked and fall back per field.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies 20261113110000 and 20261113110100 after 20261113095000 by hash, then deploys admin-ai-eval-run and ai-tarot-reading. Until then Admin names the missing migration and publishing works as before.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if PGlite, Deno tests, deno check or Admin tests fail, or if the safety layer could be skipped.
